summary: LGL Group filed an 8-K announcing a subscription rights offering for holders of common stock. Each share held as of a future record date entitles the holder to one right to purchase one share at a subscription price equal to the greater of: a 1%-5% discount to 30-day VWAP or $6.81 (book value per share as of March 31, 2026). The offering will include an over-subscription privilege. The company will list the rights on NYSE American pending approval. The register will be set once the SEC declares the Form S-1 effective. No final pricing or record date is set; watch for S-1 effectiveness and actual discount.
